description: Release request — one action an agent asks to run: its kind, the fields that define it and their digest, at a level. Filed in a collection edged by initialized_by to an initializer, it gets its approval as a part, decided by whoever holds update on the approval's home. The filer cannot decide it; trashing it withdraws it.

level.description: The id of the approval-level artifact the request is filed at. The request's collection fixes it; the type names no level.

kind.description: The kind of action, which fixes the fields it is made of.

action.description: The fields that define the action, exactly those its kind names.

action_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the kind and its fields; the run checks it against what it is about to do.

part.description: The approval made for this request when it was filed.
